workbench.template.workflowHint: Complete a task step by step, such as reports, reviews, or quizzes
workbench.template.referenceHint: Use SKILL.md as an index and keep details in reference/
workbench.template.formatHint: Output format, tone, and template constraints
workbench.name: Name
workbench.descriptionHint: What it does and when to use it
workbench.descriptionExample: For example: Turn meeting transcripts into notes with decisions and action items. Use when the user shares a transcript or asks for meeting notes.
workbench.triggerReady: A trigger scenario helps AI decide when to load this Skill
workbench.triggerHint: Add when to use it so AI can decide when to load it
workbench.manualHint: AI will not load it automatically. Mention it with $ in the composer to use it
workbench.aiQuestionHint: You can paste a conversation you were happy with
workbench.aiExample: After meetings, I will paste the transcript. Summarize conclusions and decisions, then action items with owners and deadlines, then discussion points.
workbench.folderHint: Multiple Skills in a folder will be listed separately
workbench.overwrite: Same name; will overwrite (original moves to {{trash}})
workbench.linkIntroduction: Share Skills with other AI tools. Linked Skills appear read-only under Linked folders and update when their original files change. Choose which to enable, or copy one to My Skills to edit it.
workbench.linkSelectionHint: Only selected Skills appear here. Additions and updates in the folder take effect immediately
workbench.priorityHint: For duplicate names, built-in Skills take priority, then My Skills, then linked folders.
workbench.modelRequired: Configure a model for Chat in Settings first
workbench.trust: Scripts in Skills can run on this device. Import only from trusted sources
workbench.fileHint: Files other than SKILL.md load only when AI needs them. Use them for longer references, templates, and scripts.
workbench.missingDescription: Without a description, AI cannot decide when to use it
workbench.folderIdentityHint: The folder name is the identifier AI uses. It cannot be changed here
workbench.aiDescription: Description shown to AI · Used to decide when to load
workbench.readmeDescriptionExample: For example: Turn this week’s journal, completed tasks, and events into a weekly report. Use when the user asks for a weekly report or recap.
workbench.frontmatterError: Invalid front matter ({{reason}}). Switch to Source to correct it.
workbench.deleteDescription: It will move to {{trash}}, where you can restore it.
workbench.discardDescription: This file has unsaved changes that will be lost if you leave.
